text:
Sara L.: Quick check — panel for candidate Alex T is Fri 3/20 10:00am PT. Need to confirm who is leading the debrief, who will be timekeeper, and whether we should use rubric_v2-final or the lean rubric. Also want one engineer to cover infra/ops. cc @Reena K., @Michael T., @Samir P.

Michael T.: I can run the debrief and act as timekeeper. Will add a 10m buffer after the interview for notes. Added tentative invite to the panel — please accept. Event: https://calendar.company/evt/abc123

Reena K.: I can handle infra/ops questions. Quick rubric question — current rubric treats design and execution equally; do we want to bump system design weight for this role?

Samir P.: +1 to Reena. For a senior infra role I’d weight design more. Proposal: design 40, execution 35, communication 25. Also a small wording tweak on the "ownership" criterion to clarify examples. Snippet I suggest pasting into the doc:
```
Ownership (0-4):
0: No sense of ownership; avoids follow-up
2: Takes ownership of assigned tasks; needs prompts
4: Proactively owns long-term outcomes, drives follow-through
```

people-ops-bot: Reminder — panelists please submit feedback within 48h after the interview: https://forms.company/submit-feedback :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sara L.: Thanks — @Michael T. can you add the buffer and invite Reena to the event? @Samir P. can you paste that rubric snippet into the shared debrief doc (link in event)? I’ll ask People Ops to reserve the interview room and confirm candidate logistics.

Michael T.: Done — buffer added, Reena invited. Zoom link+passcode in event. Will take initial notes in the debrief doc: https://docs.company/debriefs/alex_t

Samir P.: Snippet pasted and updated ownership scale to 0-4 in the rubric doc. Left a comment on the weighting so we can finalize before Friday. Rubric link: https://docs.company/rubrics/senior_infra_v2

Reena K.: Great — I’ll drop two infra-focused questions here by EOD Thu and share one quick follow-up prompt we can use for probing.

Sara L.: Perfect. @people-ops-bot can you send candidate confirmation + prep packet and confirm parking/office pass?

people-ops-bot: Candidate confirmation email and prep packet sent to Alex T. Office pass request submitted. :email: :white_check_mark:
